article.headline: Walker scores 16, New Haven takes down New Hampshire 50-47
article.description: — Tim Walker had 16 points in New Haven’s 50-47 win over New Hampshire on Saturday.
article.linkText: Walker scores 16, New Haven takes down New Hampshire 50-47

keywords: New Hampshire Wildcats @ New Haven Chargers
article.story: WEST HAVEN, Conn. -- — Tim Walker had 16 points in New Haven’s 50-47 win over New Hampshire on Saturday. Walker shot 7 for 14, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc for the Chargers (3-3). Zoumana Traore added eight points while going 3 of 15 (0 for 7 from 3-point range) while they also had 10 rebounds. Teshaun Steele had eight points and shot 2 of 6 from the field and 4 of 7 from the free-throw line. Ryan Zan finished with 18 points and six rebounds for the Wildcats (4-3). John Squire added 10 points and six rebounds for New Hampshire. Josiah Coleman finished with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
